question: The Olympic Games are held every ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fourth year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Olympic Games:-**

 
 
• The modern Olympic Games were revived by Pierre de Coubertin in 1896. The ancient Olympic Games were held in Olympia, Greece, from around 776 BC to 393 AD.
 
• **The Summer Olympics are held every four years, while the Winter Olympics are also held every four years but are staggered by two years from the Summer Games.**
 
• The host city and country for each Olympic Games are selected through a bidding process by the International Olympic Committee (IOC). The hosting provides an opportunity for the host country to showcase its culture, infrastructure, and hospitality.
 
• The Olympic Games feature a wide range of sports and disciplines, including athletics, swimming, gymnastics, cycling, skiing, figure skating, and more. The program can vary between the Summer and Winter Games.
 
• The Olympic rings symbolize the five continents of the world united through sports. Each ring represents a continent: Africa, the Americas, Asia, Europe, and Oceania.
